source_contract.distance_space: raw recorder RGB divided by 255; Euclidean
source_contract.nearest_neighbor_reference: leave-one-row-out nearest neighbor among the 1152 development rows
source_contract.convex_hull: scipy ConvexHull of all development recorder RGB rows

decision_branches.source_support_gap: one or more held slides exceed the fixed nearest-distance or convex-hull support threshold
decision_branches.in_support_representation_failure: all held slides remain within fixed source-support thresholds
decision_branches.integrity_failure: source table or AQ2 identities fail

claim_ceiling: source-only support attribution for the already-rejected AQ2 recorder proxy; cannot promote an operator
